question: As of April 2025, Similipal - designated as the second national park of the state - is located in:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Similipal** is a **national park** and a **tiger reserve** located in the state of **Odisha, India**.
 
• The park is part of the **Similipal-Kuldiha-Hadgarh Elephant Reserve**, which comes under the **Mayurbhanj district** of Odisha.
 
• It was declared a **national park in 1980** and is recognized as the **second national park** of the state.
 
• The name "Similipal" is derived from the abundance of **Semul trees (silk cotton trees)**, which bloom vividly in this region.
 
• Similipal is known for its **rich biodiversity**, including species like **Bengal tigers, Asian elephants, leopards, and gaurs**.
 
• The park also features a wide range of **flora and fauna**, with a mix of tropical evergreen forests, deciduous forests, and grasslands.
 
• It is famous for its **picturesque waterfalls** like **Barehipani** and **Joranda**, which are major attractions for visitors.
 
• Similipal was designated as a **UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves** in the year **2009**.
 
• The area is significant for its indigenous tribal population, including the **Ho, Munda, and Santhal tribes**, who reside in and around the park.
 
• Similipal plays a critical role in **conservation efforts** for endangered species and protecting the natural ecosystem of the Eastern Ghats region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gujarat**__

 __
 
• **Gujarat** is home to the **Gir National Park**, which is the only habitat of the **Asiatic lions** in the world.
 
• The state also features other important wildlife sanctuaries like the **Blackbuck National Park (Velavadar)** and **Marine National Park**.
 
• However, Similipal is not located in Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__
 __
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is often referred to as the "**Heart of India**" and is known for its rich wildlife.
 
• The state boasts famous national parks like **Kanha National Park**, **Bandhavgarh National Park**, and **Pench National Park**.
 
• Similipal, however, is not located in Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Assam**__
 
 
• **Assam** is renowned for the **Kaziranga National Park**, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to the **one-horned rhinoceros**.
 
• The state also has other wildlife sanctuaries like **Manas National Park** and **Dibru-Saikhowa National Park**.
 
• Similipal is not situated in Assam.
